input: Eight previously used TRAIN recordings, four actor groups, one frozen training seed
refiners: Six frozen 7-input/8-tanh/scalar-residual MLPs, three greedy supervised rounds per modality
signal_profile: 8 kHz mono PCM and 8 fps 48x48 grayscale video
actions: All 16 complete audio/video prefix pairs, each depth in 0..3
joint_loss: 0.5 * (audio raw MSE + video raw MSE); report modality losses separately
comparator: Best single prefix on the same TRAIN set; optimistic in-sample comparator
oracle: Clean-truth-looking minimum per recording; never a deployable controller
budgets: Exact and at-most forward-call counts 0..6, 100% coverage
cost: Count all prerequisite calls and 64 matrix MACs per scalar per round; not physical cost parity
eager_execution: All six forwards per clip are actually paid before diagnostic oracle selection
parity: 64 original stage losses within 1e-15; 16 final float32 arrays byte-exact
interpretation: Zero useful headroom is a valid development stop; never require a positive REFINE rate
